pages.text: Cursed cannonballs put a curse on the ship they hit and anyone they splash:$(br)$(li)$(l)Anchorball$(): drops her anchor$(li)$(l)Riggingball$(): furls her sails$(li)$(l)Ballastball$(): weighs her down$(li)$(l)Grogball$(): makes you drunk$(li)$(l)Limpball$(): slows you$(li)$(l)Venomball$(): poisons$(li)$(l)Wearyball$(): tires you$(li)$(l)Jigball$(): makes you dance
